title: Latihan 1: Deteksi Ambang Nyquist dan Simulasi Aliasing Sinyal
instruction: Tuliskan fungsi Python bernama `check_sampling_condition(f_signal, f_sampling)` yang mengembalikan tuple `(is_valid, nyquist_rate, alias_freq)`. Jika f_sampling >= 2 * f_signal, kembalikan `(True, 2 * f_signal, f_signal)`. Jika undersampled, kembalikan `(False, 2 * f_signal, abs(f_signal - round(f_signal / f_sampling) * f_sampling))`.
